full-name: James Yonge
first-name: James
last-name: Yonge
title: James Yonge
dates: (1816-2 Nov 1834)
---

cousin of CMY, second and eldest surviving son of the Rev.

John Yonge of Puslinch

Known as 'Jemmy Jummy' CMY wrote that he was 'a kind of special patron of mine';  he died at Otterbourne aged 18 [Coleridge, Life 65; tablet in Newton Ferrars church]
